verdict.summary: The change correctly centralizes the registry lane's structural reachability predicate and disposition mapping, wires both sparse-checkout workflows to all required imports, and makes verdict-bridge label writes CAS-sensitive to the selected label set. The tests exercise each reachability gate, the four measured PR shapes, stale multi-label repair, release-guard refusal, GraphQL shape parsing, census behavior, and shared-object identity; the controls prevent the principal assertions from passing vacuously. I found no correctness, soundness, test-validity, or security defect in the diff.
